items.name: SQ_DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX
items.sqlQuery: select briskbend(pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER,pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER) as ID_MEMBER, pearlforge1.MAILBOX as MAILBOX_1, pearlforge2. MAILBOX as MAILBOX_2 from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER,MAILBOX FROM (select CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, CEDARDELL.MAILBOX, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY DECODE(CEDARDELL.ID_KIND_MAILBOX,7,3,1,2,2,1,0)||lpad(CEDARDELL.NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW,3,0)DESC) AS FLINTTOWER from VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX cedardell where cedardell.fch_maplelane is null and CEDARDELL.MAILBOX is not null ) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1) pearlforge1 FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ID_MEMBER,MAILBOX FROM (select CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, CEDARDELL.MAILBOX, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY DECODE(CEDARDELL.ID_KIND_MAILBOX,7,3,1,2,2,1,0)||lpad(CEDARDELL.NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW,3,0)DESC) AS FLINTTOWER from VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX CEDARDELL where cedardell.fch_maplelane is null and CEDARDELL.MAILBOX is not null ) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 2) pearlforge2 ON pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER = pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER order by ID_MEMBER asc
items.sqlQueryTranslated: SELECT BRISKBEND(PEARLFORGE1.ID_MEMBER, PEARLFORGE2.ID_MEMBER) AS ID_MEMBER, PEARLFORGE1.MAILBOX AS MAILBOX_1, PEARLFORGE2.MAILBOX AS MAILBOX_2 FROM (SELECT ID_MEMBER, MAILBOX FROM (SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, CEDARDELL.MAILBOX, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY DECODE(CEDARDELL.ID_KIND_MAILBOX, 7, 3, 1, 2, 2, 1, 0) || LPAD(CEDARDELL.NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) DESC) AS FLINTTOWER FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX` AS CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.MAILBOX IS NOT NULL) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1) AS PEARLFORGE1 FULL JOIN (SELECT ID_MEMBER, MAILBOX FROM (SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, CEDARDELL.MAILBOX, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY DECODE(CEDARDELL.ID_KIND_MAILBOX, 7, 3, 1, 2, 2, 1, 0) || LPAD(CEDARDELL.NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) DESC) AS FLINTTOWER FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX` AS CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.MAILBOX IS NOT NULL) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 2) AS PEARLFORGE2 ON PEARLFORGE1.ID_MEMBER = PEARLFORGE2.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ID_MEMBER

items.name: SQ_DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILCODE
items.sqlQuery: SELECT ID_MEMBER, RTRIM(DESC_LOCATION) as DESC_LOCATION, BLUESPRING, DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD, DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD2, DESC_DISTRICT, DESC_CORALGATE, DESC_BIRCHYARD FROM ( select CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, cedardell.ID_KIND_LOCATION||','||cedardell.DESC_LOCATION AS DESC_LOCATION, BLUESPRING, DECODE(trim(WESTTHORP),NULL,NULL,'BOLDTRAIL:'|| trim(WESTTHORP)||' ') || DECODE(trim(WESTFORK),NULL,NULL,'WESTFORK:'|| trim(WESTFORK)||' ') || DECODE(trim(UPPERLANE),NULL,NULL,'WESTTRACK:' ||trim(UPPERLANE)||' ') || DECODE(trim(GREENDOCK),NULL,NULL, 'GREENDOCK:'|| trim(GREENDOCK))|| DECODE(trim(NAVYFIELD),NULL,NULL,'-'|| trim(NAVYFIELD)) AS DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD, DECODE(trim(GREENDOCK),NULL,NULL, trim(GREENDOCK)) || DECODE(trim(NAVYFIELD),NULL,NULL,'-' ||trim(NAVYFIELD)) AS DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD2, DESC_DISTRICT, DESC_CORALGATE, PINERIDGE.DES_BIRCHYARD AS DESC_BIRCHYARD, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY CEDARDELL.NUM_CORALPEAK ASC) AS FLINTTOWER from VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILCODE cedardell, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_CEDARVALE_BIRCHYARD PINERIDGE WHERE cedardell.fch_maplelane is null AND cedardell.ID_KIND_LOCATION||cedardell.DESC_LOCATION IS NOT NULL AND CEDARDELL.ID_BIRCHYARD = PINERIDGE.ID_BIRCHYARD (+) AND PINERIDGE.FCH_CEDARMILL (+) IS NULL ) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1 order by ID_MEMBER ASC

items.name: SQ_DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST
items.sqlQuery: select briskbend(pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER,pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER,pearlforge3.ID_MEMBER) as ID_MEMBER, pearlforge1.NUM_PINETOWER_1, pearlforge2.NUM_PINETOWER_2, pearlforge3.NUM_PINETOWER_3 from ( select DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_1, FLINTTOWER from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_1, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK1 ASC) AS FLINTTOWER FROM ( SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, DECODE (ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 2, 0, 1) || LPAD ( NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH (ROWANHOLLOW (LPAD (NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0), 0))) ROWANWICK1, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_1 FROM VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, rowanwick1 ASC)) where flinttower = 1 ) pearlforge1 FULL OUTER JOIN ( select DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_2, FLINTTOWER from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_2, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK2 ASC) AS FLINTTOWER FROM (SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, DECODE (ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 2, 1, 0) || LPAD ( ID_LOCATION, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH (ROWANHOLLOW (LPAD ( ID_LOCATION, 3, 0), 0))) rowanwick2, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_2 FROM VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, rowanwick2 ASC)) where flinttower = 1 ) pearlforge2 ON pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER = pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER FULL OUTER JOIN ( select DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_3, FLINTTOWER from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_3, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK3 ASC) AS FLINTTOWER FROM ( SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, DECODE (ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 11, 0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 3) || LPAD (NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH (ROWANHOLLOW (LPAD (NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0), 0))) ROWANWICK3, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_3 FROM VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, rowanwick3 ASC ) ) where flinttower = 1) pearlforge3 ON pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER = pearlforge3.ID_MEMBER order by ID_MEMBER asc
items.sqlQueryTranslated: SELECT BRISKBEND(PEARLFORGE1.ID_MEMBER, PEARLFORGE2.ID_MEMBER, PEARLFORGE3.ID_MEMBER) AS ID_MEMBER, PEARLFORGE1.NUM_PINETOWER_1, PEARLFORGE2.NUM_PINETOWER_2, PEARLFORGE3.NUM_PINETOWER_3 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_1, FLINTTOWER FROM (SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_1, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK1) AS FLINTTOWER FROM (SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, DECODE(ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 2, 0, 1) || LPAD(NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH(BRISKBEND(LPAD(NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0), 0))) AS ROWANWICK1, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_1 FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST` AS CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, ROWANWICK1)) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1) AS PEARLFORGE1 FULL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_2, FLINTTOWER FROM (SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_2, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK2) AS FLINTTOWER FROM (SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, DECODE(ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 2, 1, 0) || LPAD(ID_LOCATION, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH(BRISKBEND(LPAD(ID_LOCATION, 3, 0), 0))) AS ROWANWICK2, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_2 FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST` AS CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, ROWANWICK2)) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1) AS PEARLFORGE2 ON PEARLFORGE1.ID_MEMBER = PEARLFORGE2.ID_MEMBER FULL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_3, FLINTTOWER FROM (SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_3, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK3) AS FLINTTOWER FROM (SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, DECODE(ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 11, 0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 3) || LPAD(NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH(BRISKBEND(LPAD(NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0), 0))) AS ROWANWICK3, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_3 FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST` AS CEDARDELL WHERE CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, ROWANWICK3)) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1) AS PEARLFORGE3 ON PEARLFORGE1.ID_MEMBER = PEARLFORGE3.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ID_MEMBER

items.name: LKP_MOD_PACTS_MIS
items.sqlOverride: select MIS.id_member as ID_MEMBER, sum(case MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS when 1324 then IMP_CEDARMARSH else 0 end) as OAKMOOR_CEDARMARSH , sum(case MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS when 1327 then IMP_CEDARTOWER else 0 end ) as OAKMOOR_CEDARTOWER from VDX81_OWNER.MOD_PACTS MIS where MIS.ID_OAKBLUFF = (select max(ID_OAKBLUFF) from VDX81_OWNER.MOD_PACTS) and MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS in (1324, 1327) and MIS.ID_ROWANVAULT_MONETARY in (0, 2) and MIS.ID_OAKPIER_MIS = 1 group by MIS.id_member order by MIS.id_member
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT MIS.ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, SUM(CASE WHEN MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS = 1324 THEN IMP_CEDARMARSH ELSE 0 END) AS OAKMOOR_CEDARMARSH, SUM(CASE WHEN MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS = 1327 THEN IMP_CEDARTOWER ELSE 0 END) AS OAKMOOR_CEDARTOWER FROM `DWH.MOD_PACTS` AS MIS WHERE MIS.ID_OAKBLUFF = (SELECT MAX(ID_OAKBLUFF) FROM `DWH.MOD_PACTS`) AND MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS IN (1324, 1327) AND MIS.ID_ROWANVAULT_MONETARY IN (0, 2) AND MIS.ID_OAKPIER_MIS = 1 GROUP BY MIS.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY MIS.ID_MEMBER

items.name: LKP_HANDLER_ROWANPATH
items.sqlOverride: select DECODE(PINERIDGE.ID_BIRCHDOCK, NULL, '9'||substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 3, 8),PINERIDGE.ID_BIRCHDOCK) AS ID_HANDLER, BERYLWARD.ID_MEMBER as ID_MEMBER from VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_MEMBER_HANDLER BERYLWARD, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_HANDLER CEDARDELL, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLEGROVE_NORTHCLIFF PINERIDGE where BERYLWARD.ID_HANDLER = CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER (+) AND BERYLWARD.FCH_CEDARMILL IS NULL AND case when substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) is not null then substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) else case when ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 then 900 || substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) end end = pineridge.ID_HANDLER (+) AND CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER is not null and BERYLWARD.FCH_MAPLELANE is null and CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE is null and PINERIDGE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BERYLWARD.ID_KIND_OFFERING =4 order by BERYLWARD.ID_MEMBER

items.name: LKP_MOD_PACTS_CEDARLANE
items.sqlOverride: select MAPLEHEATH44.ID_MEMBER as ID_MEMBER, MIS.FCH_BIRCHGLADE as ID_BIRCHGLADE, sum(MIS.IMP_BIRCHGLADE) as IMP_TEALFORD_RUSTCOMBE from VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_ELMSTEAD MAPLEHEATH44 left join VDX81_OWNER.MOD_PACTS_CEDARLANE MIS on (MAPLEHEATH44.ID_NUCLEUS = MIS.ID_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS_NAVYGATE and MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PACT = MIS.ID_PACT) where (MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PHASE_FIRCROSS='R' OR MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PHASE_FIRCROSS='N' OR MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PHASE_FIRCROSS='MAPLEGARTH' and MAPLEHEATH44.ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING not in ('MAPLETOWER')) and MAPLEHEATH44.FCH_MAPLELANE is null and MIS.FCH_BIRCHGLADE = (select max(FCH_BIRCHGLADE) from VDX81_OWNER.LKP_FCH_PACTS_CEDARLANE) and MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS = 200 and MAPLEHEATH44.ID_KIND_PLUMMILL = 1 group by MAPLEHEATH44.ID_MEMBER, MIS.FCH_BIRCHGLADE order by MAPLEHEATH44.ID_MEMBER
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT MAPLEHEATH44.ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, MIS.FCH_BIRCHGLADE AS ID_BIRCHGLADE, SUM(MIS.IMP_BIRCHGLADE) AS IMP_TEALFORD_RUSTCOMBE FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_ELMSTEAD` AS MAPLEHEATH44 LEFT JOIN `DWH.MOD_PACTS_CEDARLANE` AS MIS ON MAPLEHEATH44.ID_NUCLEUS = MIS.ID_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS_NAVYGATE AND MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PACT = MIS.ID_PACT WHERE (MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PHASE_FIRCROSS = 'R' OR MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PHASE_FIRCROSS = 'N' OR MAPLEHEATH44.ID_PHASE_FIRCROSS = 'MAPLEGARTH' AND MAPLEHEATH44.ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING NOT IN ('MAPLETOWER')) AND MAPLEHEATH44.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND MIS.FCH_BIRCHGLADE = (SELECT MAX(FCH_BIRCHGLADE) FROM `CDM.LKP_FCH_PACTS_CEDARLANE`) AND MIS.ID_AMBERFALLS = 200 AND MAPLEHEATH44.ID_KIND_PLUMMILL = 1 GROUP BY MAPLEHEATH44.ID_MEMBER, MIS.FCH_BIRCHGLADE ORDER BY MAPLEHEATH44.ID_MEMBER
